responsibility: This Texinfo file documents the ISO-flavored `SYSTEM` definition module for GNU Modula-2, describing the low-level, target-sensitive programming interface that the GM2 front end and runtime expose for ISO mode. It specifies storage-layout constants and machine-related types such as `LOC`, `BYTE`, `WORD`, and `ADDRESS`; address arithmetic and type-transfer operations like `ADDADR`, `SUBADR`, `DIFADR`, `MAKEADR`, `ADR`, `CAST`, and `TSIZE`; bit-manipulation facilities including `SHIFT`, `ROTATE`, and `TBITSIZE`; the GCC exception bridge `THROW`; and the runtime helper procedures (`ShiftVal`, `ShiftLeft/Right`, `RotateVal`, `RotateLeft/Right`) used to implement multiword set shifts and rotates that the compiler may inline or lower to runtime calls depending on size and compile-time knowledge.
